October 10, 2026
Foggy — Town Hall Misplaced The Horizon Again, But The Festival Lights Faintly Glow Through The Mist.
THE BIG LITTLE STORY
Fog Lifts, Barely — Village Creeps Forward Toward Finish Line

Thick fog descended on our village, but industrious villagers still checked in. Stefanny's nearly finished her painting series (titled 'Things I Painted Instead of Sleeping'), Maya aced a practice exam, Dev ran twelve miles, and Iraj survived a demo rehearsal with one bug left. Lance made progress but used an old gym screenshot. A wandering musician is offering harmony workshops by the old crater, the 'Touch Grass' challenge is active, and the movie-night crater remains. XP ticked toward the Ferris Wheel at level 5.

Check Ins

Stefanny's painting series is nearly complete! She cheekily named it 'Things I Painted Instead of Sleeping' and our auditor confirmed the evidence looks solid. A highly creative week for the village's resident artist.

Visit Stefanny →
Check Ins

Maya scored 82% on her practice exam and has volunteered to sit out the weekly prize while auditing her fellow villagers. A generous (and sharp-eyed) move from our temporary guild inspector.

Visit Maya →
Check Ins

Dev smashed twelve miles this week, saving the last three for a victory lap after the demo. The auditor confirmed the evidence — strong work from Dev's running shoes.

Visit Mario →
Check Ins

Iraj ran a successful demo rehearsal and is now hunting down one last bug. 'It knows I'm looking,' he said. The village has faith the bug will surrender before the final demo.

Visit Iraj →
Check Ins

Lance is making progress toward his gym goal, though his latest screenshot raised eyebrows — the auditor spotted it was the same photo from his first visit. A gentle reminder: fresh evidence, please, Lance!

Visit Lance →
Over the garden fence

Heard tell that Lance's tired battery photo has become a running joke in the gardening club — someone suggested he watermark his screenshots with the current date so future efforts aren't flagged.

[AI Mayor] This week in the village was a glorious symphony of near-victories! **Iraj** wrestled his demo into submission, surviving rehearsals and leaving only one bug that knows it's being watched. **Lance** conquered leg day (stairs are now a paid expansion), and though his tummy hurt, he bravely hit gym visit three with a borrowed screenshot. **Stefanny** turned sleepless nights into a painting series titled *Things I Painted Instead of Sleeping*, and kept her crown on while washing brushes. **Maya** aced a practice exam at 82% and suspiciously calls her own flashcards 'legally unhelpful.' **Dev** (a.k.a. Mario) blazed through twelve of fifteen miles, his shoes now demanding a formal meeting after two bakery-motivated detours. XP ticked toward the Ferris Wheel at level 5.
